status.headline: strong development candidate / not clinically validated / not yet shipped
status.previous_status: strong development candidate; NOT a shipped field

loao_refit_archive_held_out.ruler: baseline is the majority answer of the TRAINING archives; the held-out archive's own prevalence is unknown at deployment
loao_refit_archive_held_out.difference_from_ladder_loao: each archive is held out of TRAINING and the model refit; the ladder's loao() only partitions pooled OOF predictions and never refits

preprocessing.nan_semantics: zero detections means count 0 but ratio UNDEFINED; ratios stay NaN with explicit flags and are zero-imputed after scaling, never median-imputed (a fold-wise median would leak)

detector.justification: this detector trained only on external images -- zero local images, labels or folds -- so it cannot leak into any local validation fold and one checkpoint legitimately serves every fold

validation_discipline.how: validation cases receive only automatically detected regions; human boxes are supervision inside training folds only -- and for this arm the detector saw no local box at all
validation_discipline.locked_note: this run only; locked-47 has been consumed 7 times historically and had model selection done on it, so it is a CONSUMED internal holdout, not a clean final test set

permitted_values.low_band_correspondence: the image corresponds to the report's <=10% malformation band
permitted_values.high_band_correspondence: the image corresponds to the report's >10% malformation band
permitted_values.unknown: no usable reading -- NOT a normal finding, and must never be rendered as one
permitted_values.rejected: input or confidence failed a precondition; the field is withheld

forbidden_outputs: any three-band low/medium/high wording -- the model is binary and cannot separate 10--30% from >60%; those were one training label
output_semantics.why_not_three_bands: ADMISSIBLE['malformation_ratio'] is 'binary <=10% vs >10%'. The three abnormal bands are one training label, so the model has never been shown the difference between them and cannot report it.
output_semantics.why_not_a_percentage: human boxes fall inside their own clinical band for 17 of 44 cases with roughly a 3x scale offset, so a percentage would assert a calibration that does not exist

superseded_by_this_amendment.permitted: ordinal correspondence with the report's low / medium / high malformation wording
superseded_by_this_amendment.forbidden: malformed-vessel percentage, or any per-mm / micron value
superseded_by_this_amendment.why: human boxes fall inside their own clinical band for 17 of 44 cases with roughly a 3x scale offset, so a percentage would assert a calibration that does not exist

external_data_licence.source: the dataset card's own YAML front matter, data/Capillary-Dataset/README.md
external_data_licence.obligations: Apache-2.0 requires the licence text and attribution be retained; cite Nguyen & Jeong, KDD 2025
external_data_licence.used_for: vessel-morphology detector initialisation only; the external diabetes labels were NOT used as patient labels for this project
external_data_licence.adoption_criterion_8: satisfied -- Apache-2.0 permits the target deployment

what_this_freeze_does_not_establish: external validity: all three archives are one site, so no result here is an external test
a shipped field: promotion requires a new, never-accessed test set of the same field definition with per-case independence
a calibrated percentage: the permitted output is ordinal only

adoption_criteria.scope: these are RESEARCH-CANDIDATE conditions on development data. Passing them all would still not be a launch decision.

criterion_6_product_bar.bar: 70% coverage with 85% accuracy (project engineering standard, not a regulatory or field-wide threshold)
criterion_6_product_bar.note: the earlier record scored this as satisfied; it was not. The abstention table was already in the freeze.

criterion_8_licence.previous_wording: satisfied -- Apache-2.0 permits the target deployment

changes: output semantics corrected from three ordinal bands to the binary band correspondence the model actually learned
unknown and rejected added as first-class output values
adoption criterion 6 re-scored as FAILING (0.7876 at 69.75% coverage against an 85% bar)
